candidates.statement: The map z 7→z + √ 2 of the Hecke-Farey coordinates induces a rotation of M4(5) through 2π/5 about the centre 1 0.
candidates.proof_excerpt: As we are working modulo 5 in in M4(5) the transformation has order 5 and fixes the centre 1 0. (Here we are identifying the Hecke-Farey coordinate with its corresponding vertex.)

candidates.statement: A Farey circuit is a collection of points v0, v1, · · · vn each with a Hecke-Farey coordinate such that vi is adjacent to vi+1 and v0 = vn. A Farey circuit on M4(5) is given by H2, E1, F2, B1, J2, K1, C2, L1, E2, B1, F2, D1, H2 (12 vertices). For example H2 = 2 √ is adjacent to E1 = √ 2 and E1 is adjacent to F2 = √ 3 , etc. We continue this Farey sequence just by adding multiples of √
